A girl on deck raised her hand, and the keeper raised the bottle, though he knew she was too far away to see it clearly.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡的街口，昨夜的雨留在砖缝里。早餐铺拉起卷帘，蒸汽缓缓漫过玻璃。清洁工推车经过，车轮轻响，惊动树上的鸟。远处一扇窗忽然亮了，有人起身，也有人刚刚睡去。第一班公交还没到站，天空已在楼群背后悄悄泛白。风穿过天桥，带来一点面包的香气。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a box with a toy.\n- A recursive program needs a stopping rule, like stopping when you find the toy, so it does not repeat forever."}
